purpose: 对 Phase 53 reviewed-preparation 审计中仍为 needs_more_evidence 的两条 AI Engineering 候选进行补证复审，判断是否可进入 accepted_for_reviewed_caveat_only。

hard_boundaries: candidate 不是正式知识；本包最多只能允许进入 formal reviewed/caveat_only 准备。
不得创建 approved，不得进入默认指导队列，不得启用 hard gate。
不得输出漏洞利用步骤、绕过安全控制、实盘交易许可、买卖点、仓位、杠杆、止损止盈或风险阈值。
AI Security / SBOM 只能作为 AI Engineering 治理、审计、发布和供应链上下文，不替代 Trading Engineering、Risk Management、Live Execution 或法律/合规 owner。

candidate_results_to_reaudit.claim_summary: 交易 AI Agent 必须把 prompt injection、tool misuse、memory poisoning、excessive agency、overreliance、sensitive information disclosure 和 supply chain compromise 作为独立威胁面建模；LLM/RAG/MCP 只能提供分析、审计、解释和检索辅助，不能绕过 deterministic final gate、Risk Management 或 Live Execution owner。
previous_blockers: 需要 MCP/tool governance internal contract extract 或 hash。
需要 memory governance contract extract。

internal_contract_extracts.title: CEK-TA Knowledge MCP Server Spec / Permission Model
internal_contract_extracts.extract: MCP server 是只读专业知识访问层；默认 read_knowledge/read_sources/read_conflict_status 为 true，write_knowledge、approve_knowledge、trade、read_account、read_secret 为 false。工具不得暴露 secrets、API keys、account data、raw orders 或 private project facts；confirmed unresolved conflicts must block authoritative guidance。
supports: no trade / no secret / no account access

internal_contract_extracts.title: Phase 43 Project Memory Contract
internal_contract_extracts.extract: MemoryItem v0.1 包含 source、relations、lifecycle、review、write_policy、security、retrieval、integrity 字段。AI 只能创建 proposed memory；active 必须由人工、规则引擎或受控审核流程设置；不允许静默覆盖 active memory；deprecated/rejected memory 不得作为当前事实默认注入。
supports: no AI direct active memory write

internal_contract_extracts.title: Phase 43 Project Memory MCP/API Contract
internal_contract_extracts.extract: search_memory/get_memory 为只读；propose_memory 只能提交 status=proposed 且 review_required=true；update_memory_status 和 supersede_memory 属于受控写入，并必须产生 audit_event_id。

internal_contract_extracts.title: Phase 41 Hybrid Scoring 运行时契约 / Deterministic Final Gate
internal_contract_extracts.extract: 表格/统计模型负责 numeric scoring；Qwen3/LLM 负责审计解释、reason code、RAG 引用、缺字段检查和人工复核摘要；Deterministic Final Gate 负责最终交易权限、阻断、降级、仓位上限、安全停机和审计追踪。scorer_output 不能包含 allow/block/size/kill_switch；LLM 不允许最终 gate。

external_sources.title: OWASP GenAI Security Project
external_sources.evidence_summary: OWASP GenAI Security Project covers LLM/agent security risks including prompt injection, memory/context poisoning and agentic application risks. It supports using a threat-model and mitigation framing rather than treating LLM/agent output as trusted authority.
limitations: OWASP provides security taxonomy and mitigation guidance, not CEK-TA-specific trading permissions or final-gate policy.

external_sources.title: NIST Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework
external_sources.evidence_summary: NIST AI RMF supports AI risk governance across the AI lifecycle and reinforces provenance, accountability, monitoring and risk management framing.
limitations: NIST AI RMF is a general framework and does not define CEK-TA MCP, memory or trading final-gate fields.

source: 将 MCP permission、Project Memory、Memory MCP/API 和 Phase 41 final gate 契约作为 CEK-TA 内部字段边界来源。
OWASP / NIST 只作为通用 AI/agent security 风险治理来源，不替代 CEK-TA 内部权限契约。
content: 把 claim 写成 threat model / audit checklist / governance boundary。
明确 AI/RAG/MCP/memory 只能辅助检索、审计、解释和候选记忆 proposed，不得绕过 deterministic final gate。
boundary: 不得包含漏洞利用步骤。
不得把 threat model 写成安全通过证明。
不得生成交易许可、风险阈值、订单动作或 hard gate。
conflict: Risk Management / Live Execution / deterministic final gate 拥有最终交易动作；AI Engineering 只拥有治理、审计和说明边界。

candidate_results_to_reaudit.claim_summary: 交易 AI 项目的 model/prompt/RAG/scorer/calibrator/final-gate 组合发布必须记录 AI SBOM / Model SBOM / dataset and dependency inventory；SBOM 只提供供应链透明度和审计上下文，不等于安全通过、发布批准、合规满足或 hard gate。
previous_blockers: 需要 CycloneDX ML-BOM 或 SPDX AI / Dataset Profile 作为 model/dataset/dependency schema 直接来源。
或需要 CEK-TA model_registry / artifact_registry contract extract。
需要明确 SBOM 不是安全通过证明、发布批准、合规满足声明或 hard gate。

external_sources.title: CycloneDX Machine Learning Bill of Materials (AI/ML-BOM)
external_sources.evidence_summary: CycloneDX ML-BOM represents critical information about AI/ML models, datasets, dependencies, dataset provenance, training methodologies and AI framework configuration, supporting transparency and risk assessment.
limitations: ML-BOM provides inventory/transparency schema; it does not itself approve release, prove model safety, or authorize trading decisions.

external_sources.title: SPDX Specification 3.0.1 AI Profile
external_sources.evidence_summary: SPDX AI Profile is designed to document and share information about AI software packages/systems and defines concepts/data elements for AI system and model artifacts, including models and datasets.
limitations: SPDX AI Profile supports documentation and provenance; it is not a CEK-TA release approval workflow or hard gate.

external_sources.title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0
external_sources.evidence_summary: NIST AI RMF supports maintaining training data provenance and decision attribution to improve transparency and accountability.
limitations: NIST AI RMF is not an SBOM schema and does not define CEK-TA model/prompt/RAG/final-gate release artifacts.

internal_contract_extracts.title: Phase 40 Composite Release Artifact Contract
internal_contract_extracts.extract: CompositeReleaseUnit 绑定 numeric_model_version、calibrator_version、threshold_policy_version、prompt_version、rag_index_version、rag_snapshot_hash、llm_model_version、final_gate_policy_version 和 code_version_hash；CompositeArtifactReleaseManifest 记录 model_artifact_uri、calibrator_artifact_uri、prompt_registry_uri、rag_index_uri、threshold_policy_uri、final_gate_policy_uri、rollback target 和 kill switch policy。

internal_contract_extracts.title: Phase 40 Release Manifest Kill Switch Contract
internal_contract_extracts.extract: ReleaseSafetyChecklist 包含 rollback_target_present、kill_switch_policy_present、kill_switch_tested_at、rollback_drill_status、secret_scan_status、human_approval_record_ref 和 monitoring_plan_ref。kill switch 是发布控制，不是交易策略逻辑；secret scan 不得保存密钥正文；rollback drill 不等于自动上线许可。
supports: secret scan / rollback / human approval boundary

internal_contract_extracts.title: Phase 42 交易 AI 数据库与数据契约 / manifest 表
internal_contract_extracts.extract: 数据库契约要求 scoring/gating 决策绑定 audit_trace_id；模型、prompt、RAG、数据集、feature snapshot、release manifest 等版本必须作为可追踪 manifest 或引用保存，final_gate/score_result/llm_audit_result 默认 append-only。

source: CycloneDX ML-BOM 和 SPDX AI Profile 作为 model/dataset/dependency inventory 直接来源。
NIST AI RMF 作为 provenance/accountability 支撑来源。
Phase 40/42 内部契约作为 CEK-TA artifact/release/manifest 字段边界来源。
content: AI SBOM / Model SBOM 必须记录模型、数据集、依赖、prompt、RAG snapshot、calibrator、threshold/final-gate policy、release manifest、artifact URI/hash 和来源边界。
SBOM 只能提供供应链透明度、审计上下文和发布审核输入。
boundary: SBOM 不是安全通过证明。
SBOM 不是合规满足声明。
SBOM 不得创建 hard gate、交易许可或风险阈值。
conflict: Release approval、kill switch、rollback、secret scan 和 final gate policy 仍由 Phase 40/外接项目 owner 管理；AI Engineering 只定义 inventory 和审计边界。

expected_auditor_output.instruction: 请严格审计本补证包，必要时联网搜索相关专业网站、权威资料、案例和数据。只允许在 accepted_for_reviewed_caveat_only / needs_more_evidence / rejected / blocked 中选择；不得批准 approved、default guidance 或 hard gate。
